verdict.rationale: Evidence shows only manual QR-scan/setup-key entry, GUI import/export, and a CLI limited to exporting and decrypting backups—no documented API, SDK, or CLI subcommand for programmatically creating or updating vault entries. No OpenAPI/API surface was found (ente-auth-probe-3 confirms no openapi.json), so an agent has no documented programmatic surface to seed or update TOTP secrets.
